content.short: Saffron is a peer-to-peer risk adjustment protocol that transforms underlying yield into tranches.
content.description: Saffron lets participants adjust their risk exposure against each other, transforming an underlying yield stream so that one side takes more risk for more return and the other side takes less of both. It is one of the longer-running protocols in this category and now operates on Monad and Robinhood Chain.
